hook: Ticket ka nishaan... mere khoon ka nishaan
hook_text: Ticket ka nishaan… mere khoon ka nishaan
feedback: The script is exceptionally well-paced, captures the exact eerie Indian railway horror vibe, and uses strong visual contrasts (warm lantern vs. cold moonlight). The twist at the end lands effectively without relying on gore. Dialogue and narration follow the natural spoken Hindi style well. Keep this exact rhythm and structure for future reels.
lines: Ticket ka nishaan... mere khoon ka nishaan
Par ye sab shuru hua teen din pehle...
Raat ke teen baje, tunnel ki andheri hawa mein train ruk gayi
Dadi ne rudraksha mala diya, "beta, yaad rakhna"
Train ki battery dead, bahar sirf ghana andhera tha
Tabhi purane zamane ka TC, lal lantern haath mein aaya
Puncher ki aawaz... ticket par jala hua nishaan
Yeh train kabhi rukti hi nahi...
Woh nishaan bees saal pehle ki train durghatna ka tha
Aur Sameer ko samajh aaya... wo kabhi ghar nahi pahuncha tha
